name: Del Amo Fashion Center
description: Del Amo Fashion Center is one of the largest shopping destinations on the West Coast, offering an exceptional mix of premium retailers, department stores, and dining options in the heart of Torrance's South Bay region. This expansive enclosed regional mall features a modern, recently renovated interior with over 200 specialty stores including major anchors like Nordstrom, Macy's, and JCPenney. As a premier shopping destination, Del Amo serves the affluent communities of the South Bay area with a sophisticated retail experience combining fashion, lifestyle brands, and entertainment venues.
demographics: Del Amo Fashion Center attracts a diverse, middle to upper-middle class demographic with a median household income of $70,000-$90,000 in the surrounding South Bay trade area. The primary visitor base consists of families with children, young professionals aged 25-45, and affluent Asian-American shoppers who represent a significant portion of the Torrance population. The center serves as a regional destination drawing from a 15-mile radius including Manhattan Beach, Redondo Beach, and the Palos Verdes Peninsula, with visitors seeking a mix of fashion, dining, and entertainment options typical of upscale suburban shopping patterns.
summary: Del Amo Fashion Center is one of the largest and most premier regional shopping destinations on the West Coast, serving the affluent South Bay communities with over 200 stores and upscale retail offerings.
